text:
ravi: Heads up: staging run of the onboarding sample app created duplicate outbound webhook deliveries when a 429 happened during token auto-refresh. No user error reported, but doubled events in the webhook consumer :grimace:

emma: can you share the retry/auth settings used in the demo?

ravi: sample config pasted below. we had jitter turned off to keep demos deterministic (bad idea):
```js
retries: 2,
baseBackoffMs: 100,
jitter: 0, // deterministic for demo
enableSafeReplay: false,
tokenAutoRefresh: true,
```

jordan: classic. jitter=0 + token flip means concurrent retries line up and replay side-effects. safeReplay false removes the SDK protection.

li: suggestion: update quickstart template to enable safeReplay by default and use randomized jitter. also add a short onboarding lint that warns when tokenAutoRefresh==true and enableSafeReplay==false.

ravi: quick experiment: switched to jitter uniform(150,700) + enableSafeReplay=true and hit 2000 concurrent trials; zero duplicate deliveries observed. i'll add an e2e that simulates token rotation + intermittent 429s.

emma: also remind users to include Idempotency-Key for any non-idempotent external ops in the quickstart docs. small example:
```http
POST /v1/webhook-event
Idempotency-Key: 3f8c9a2b-xxxx
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

jordan: for SDK parity: ensure node/go/python quickstart templates and defaults match. open a ticket and assign.

ravi: plan: PR to update sampleapp config, add the e2e, add the onboarding lint/warning (non-blocking), and docs blurb about idempotency. opt-out flag for private deployments.

devbot: PR checklist created: update sampleapp, add e2e, docs update, SDK parity ticket. https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/5678 :white_check_mark:

li: one more UX note: for local dev we can provide a dev-only switch that keeps jitter predictable but warns prominently that its unsafe for production.

emma: +1. thanks team. ravi please post CI results back here when the PR lands.
